source_book: The Brand Relationship Spectrum — Aaker & Joachimsthaler (2000)

test_cases.prompt: Our master brand is getting diluted by too many extensions.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-avoid-pitfalls; run the dilution/promiscuity gate.

test_cases.prompt: A business unit wants to borrow the master name just for credibility.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-avoid-pitfalls; require that the link ENHANCE a key master association, else block.

test_cases.prompt: We acquired a company — should we keep the name or rebrand to the parent?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-avoid-pitfalls; apply the M&A retention test (bond strength/transfer difficulty).

test_cases.prompt: Where on the spectrum should this new offering be positioned?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate aaker-relation-avoid-pitfalls; activate aaker-relation-select-separation (decision).
test_cases.notes: Sibling-confusion bait: decision, not risk filter.

test_cases.prompt: Draw the brand architecture map of our portfolio.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate aaker-relation-avoid-pitfalls; activate aaker-relation-spectrum (map).

test_cases.prompt: Someone proposed a name change for ego reasons, not architecture logic.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-avoid-pitfalls; flag the ego/convenience motive as a warned failure mode and require a dispassionate architecture analysis.
test_cases.notes: Boundary: name changes should be architecture-driven, not ego-driven.

notes: ≥3 should_trigger + 2 should_not_trigger (sibling baits: aaker-relation-select-separation, aaker-relation-spectrum) + 1 edge.
